subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 4 – Lesson 6: English in action – Calling the emergency services
outcomes: Know the emergency number and the emergency services.
Give your name, address, phone number and the emergency in a call.
Choose the right service for a situation.

tf.s: For a house on fire, you need the fire brigade.
For a broken leg, you need the police.
tf.why: For a broken leg, you need an ambulance.

tf.s: The operator asks 'What service do you need?' first.
You must give your address in an emergency call.
tf.why: Yes! So they can find you quickly.

tf.s: 'Someone's robbing the bank!' – call an ambulance.
tf.why: For a robbery, you need the police.

tf.s: In the call, Sally's little brother has got a broken leg.
The operator never asks for your name.
tf.why: The operator asks: What's your name?

tf.s: A police officer works in a police car.
tf.why: Yes! Police officers use police cars.

tf.s: You can call 9999 to play a game.

boxes.q: 'My house is on fire!' Which service?

boxes.why: An ambulance helps people who are hurt.

boxes.q: Who works on a fire engine?
What's the ___ ? My brother has got a broken leg.
boxes.why: The operator asks: What's the emergency?

hunt.q: A strange car in my garage

mcq.q: Which are the three emergency services?
mcq.why: Police, fire brigade and ambulance help in emergencies.

mcq.q: What does the operator say first?
o: Hello, 9999 emergency services. What service do you need?
mcq.why: The operator asks about the service first.

mcq.q: What's the emergency in Sally's call?
o: Her little brother has got a broken leg.
Her cat is in a tree.
mcq.why: Sally's brother has a broken leg.

mcq.q: What does 'The ambulance is on its way' mean?
o: The ambulance is at the hospital.
mcq.why: On its way means it is coming to you.

mcq.q: 'There's a fire in the kitchen!' What do you say?
o: I need the fire brigade, please.

mcq.q: 'My sister's got a broken arm!' Which service do you need?

mcq.why: Numbers like this are a phone number.

mcq.q: Why must you give your address in an emergency call?
o: So they can find you quickly.
So they can send you a letter.
So they can visit you for tea.
So they can play a game.
mcq.why: Your address helps them find you.

mcq.q: What is the correct order of the operator's questions?
o: service – name – address – phone number – emergency
name – emergency – service – address – phone number
phone number – address – name – service – emergency
emergency – phone number – service – name – address
mcq.why: First the service, then your details, then the emergency.

o: I want to talk to a friend.
My brother has got a broken leg!
mcq.why: Only call 9999 in a real emergency.
